description: This file contains implementation of the CuttlefishConfig class related to environment-specific configurations, including methods for accessing and modifying environment parameters such as paths, socket paths, and feature toggles.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific
classes.description: Provides accessors for environment-specific configuration data within CuttlefishConfig.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific
classes.description: Provides mutator methods for environment-specific configuration data within CuttlefishConfig.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::Dictionary
methods.description: Returns a modifiable reference to the environment-specific configuration dictionary.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::Dictionary (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the environment-specific configuration dictionary.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::Dictionary
methods.description: Returns a modifiable reference to the environment-specific configuration dictionary.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::environment_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::environment_uds_dir
methods.description: Returns the UDS directory path for the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::PerEnvironmentUdsPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a file within the environment's UDS directory.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::environment_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::PerEnvironmentPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a file within the environment's directory.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::PerEnvironmentLogPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a log file within the environment's log directory.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::PerEnvironmentGrpcSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a gRPC socket within the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::control_socket_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the environment's control socket.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::launcher_log_path
methods.description: Returns the full path to the launcher log file.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::casimir_nci_socket_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the Casimir NCI socket.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::casimir_rf_socket_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the Casimir RF socket.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_enable_wifi
methods.description: Sets the enable_wifi flag in the environment configuration.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::enable_wifi
methods.description: Returns whether WiFi is enabled in the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_start_wmediumd
methods.description: Sets the start_wmediumd flag in the environment configuration.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::start_wmediumd
methods.description: Returns whether wmediumd is started in the environment.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_vhost_user_mac80211_hwsim
methods.description: Sets the vhost_user_mac80211_hwsim path in the environment configuration.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::vhost_user_mac80211_hwsim
methods.description: Returns the vhost_user_mac80211_hwsim path.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_wmediumd_api_server_socket
methods.description: Sets the wmediumd API server socket path.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::wmediumd_api_server_socket
methods.description: Returns the wmediumd API server socket path.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_wmediumd_config
methods.description: Sets the wmediumd configuration string.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::wmediumd_config
methods.description: Returns the wmediumd configuration string.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_wmediumd_mac_prefix
methods.description: Sets the wmediumd MAC prefix.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::wmediumd_mac_prefix
methods.description: Returns the wmediumd MAC prefix.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific::set_group_uuid
methods.description: Sets the group UUID.

methods.name: CuttlefishConfig::EnvironmentSpecific::group_uuid
methods.description: Returns the group UUID.
